title: Identity / Typography introduction
slide_intent: Treat type as part of voice because people hear character in the appearance of words as well as their literal meaning.
strategic_value: A distinctive typeface and consistent guidance can make Duolingo’s language-centered identity recognizable in text.
demonstration: The typography introduction connects the company’s focus on language with the development of its typeface and usage guidance.
practical_value: Evaluate typography as an expressive brand choice before selecting sizes and roles.
